verdict: Clean, fully real implementation. Uses genuine Baklava API end to end: <bl-tab-group> with <bl-tab slot="tabs" name=...> and <bl-tab-panel tab=...> (slots and the tab/name/tab attributes all match the CEM), plus a <bl-tooltip placement="top"> whose <bl-button slot="tooltip-trigger" size="small" icon="info"> trigger and default-slot content use the real tooltip-trigger slot and valid button attrs. Correct nesting (bl-tab / bl-tab-panel inside bl-tab-group), no wrapper <div>, no inline styles, no hallucinated members.
